<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR (methyl doublet, benzylic CH₂ doublet, secondary CH quartet, methoxy singlet, and para‑disubstituted aromatic pattern) and the ¹³C NMR (ester carbonyl at 166 ppm, methoxy carbon at 52 ppm, three aliphatic carbons, and six aromatic carbons), the compound is a para‑substituted methyl benzoate bearing a –CH₂‑CH(CH₃)– side chain. The structure corresponds to methyl 4‑(1‑methyl‑ethyl)benzoate. Its SMILES representation is:
